
Permissions for an agent using hm

  Strict: only commands with no side effects are allowed.

  8 path(s) denied outright: secrets, customer data, and what is
  generated rather than written. See docs/ai-context.md.

{
  "permissions": {
    "allow": [
      "Bash(hm ai-doctor:*)",
      "Bash(hm compatibility:*)",
      "Bash(hm completion:*)",

      "Bash(hm bash:*)",

  Copy this into your agent's settings. Nothing was written for you: your
  configuration file is yours, and may have rules that matter to you.
